items.headline: The AssemblyAI voice hackathon closes 2026-09-30, and one founder step is still open.
why: Five equal winners share ten thousand dollars: a thousand in cash and a thousand in speech credits each.
We are enrolled. The open step is yours: confirm the hackathon credits are attached to the speech account.
items.rationale: The only open step is a quick check on your side, and the entry closes 2026-09-30.

items.headline: Nine app-context findings need your call. The first: intel's agent guide does not inherit the fleet's root context.
why: Each fix is small. In intel, it is a short inheritance pointer in the agent guide.
In hyper-cv, the Claude guide becomes a plain import of the agent guide.
Two proof-of-concept apps get a short guide that inherits the root context.

items.headline: Two skill-routing findings need your call. The first: the routing table names the contest skill, and that skill is not installed.
why: The fix is to install the skill, or correct its name in the routing contract.
Then one sync command brings the agent guide back in line.
